summary: CenterPoint Energy Inc., CenterPoint Energy Houston Electric LLC, and CenterPoint Energy Resources Corp. jointly filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) dated September 14, 2026, with no special-situation transaction disclosed in the excerpt. The filing identifies registered securities, including CNP common stock and legacy 6.95% general mortgage bonds due 2033 and 6.625% senior notes due 2037, and confirms that Rule 425, 14a-12, 14d-2(b), and 13e-4(c) boxes were not checked. No price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing date is stated.
